atoms.text: Frank and his grandson, Gordon, are best friends. They are both fascinated by aeroplanes and the fact that these huge machines can fly through the sky without falling. Every time the sun is out, they go to a park near their house and play with their home-made aeroplane.

instruction.text: Does this picture match the story?
Why does this picture work with the text?

b.sound: The picture shows a grandfather and grandson playing with a home-made aeroplane.
The picture shows them in the park while it is raining.
Both of them are about to take off in a real aeroplane.

instruction.text: What else can you see in the picture?

b.sound: Gordon is sitting on his grandfathers shoulders.
